summary_for_david.description: Three sentences for a product owner who cannot read code: what this round was about, whether anything should worry him, and the one thing worth his attention.

what_happened.description: The round in plain English, finding by finding: what the reviewer was worried about in terms of outcomes, what the builder did about it, and whether the diff bears that out. Prose, in whatever shape reads best.

disagreements.description: Where your reading of the round differs from the builder's account. An empty array is a real answer; never pad it and never suppress an item.

what.description: What the builder's account says, and what you think instead.

why_it_matters.description: What it would mean for David or for the work if you are right.

could_not_assess.description: One sentence when something in this round was beyond what you were given -- a cut diff, a missing file, a finding you did not follow. null when there is no such thing. Not for hedging: David is told 'partial' rather than 'agrees' whenever this is set.

recommendation.description: One line: what, if anything, David should do.
